entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling to return my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your order number?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. It's a great device, just not for me. The thing is, I actually tried to return this weeks ago, well within the first 10 days, but I hit a major website error.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened on the website?

The entire returns portal seemed to be having a system down event. I filled everything out, but the final page wouldn't load. I couldn't print the label or get any confirmation. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I figured this might happen.

I see. I appreciate you explaining that and for being so proactive. Let me check my internal bulletins for that time frame... Yes, it looks like we did have a known outage with the returns portal that week. My apologies that you were affected by that. Let me just check the policy for you.
Okay, I've pulled up the return eligibility. According to our policy, your VeloBand is well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, it's 90 days? That's a relief. I was a bit worried since it had been almost a month.

Absolutely no problem. Given that it's within the window, and considering the system issue you encountered, I can approve this return for a full refund right away. I'm emailing the prepaid return label to you as we speak.

That's fantastic, thank you. Since I did have to call in because of that website problem, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I was thinking of trying one of your smart scales instead.

That's a reasonable question. However, since I'm processing a full refund for this order, my system unfortunately won't let me issue a separate discount code at the same time. But the return is all set for you.
Okay, that's fair. The full refund was the main thing. I appreciate you taking care of it so quickly.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the band back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
